blurb: Glen Annie Golf Club offers an 18-hole championship golf course with scenic views of the Pacific Ocean and Santa Ynez Mountains. Guests can play public tee times, join club memberships for discounted rates, participate in tournaments, or host corporate events. Facilities include a driving range, clubhouse with patios and event lawns, and rental clubs.
